title: Utility-Level-Dependent Ambiguity
abstract: arXiv:2609.11748v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Experimental evidence suggests that ambiguity-sensitive choice can vary systematically with the circumstances of a decision. This paper isolates one channel within a stable preference relation: ambiguity weighting may depend on the act's certainty-equivalent level. After the standard Anscombe-Aumann calibration of consequence utility, a set of behavioral axioms yields a unique continuous family of normalized monotone capacities $\{\nu_v\}_{v\in(0,1)}$. Each nonendpoint act is evaluated by the Choquet integral associated with the capacity at its own interior certainty-equivalent level, while nonendpoint acts on the same indifference surface share the same capacity. Binary event comparisons identify local event weights at each elicited level and trace their cross-level variation, providing tests of the fixed-capacity restriction. translated_title: 效用水平依赖的模糊性
translated_abstract: 实验证据表明，对模糊性敏感的选择会随决策环境发生系统性变化。本文在稳定的偏好关系内分离出其中一个渠道：模糊性权重可能依赖于行为的确定性等价水平。在对结果效用进行标准的 Anscombe-Aumann 校准之后，一组行为公理产生了一个唯一的连续规范化单调容量族 {ν_v}，其中 v ∈ (0,1)。每个非端点行为都用与其自身内部确定性等价水平相对应的容量的 Choquet 积分来评估，而位于同一无差异曲面上的非端点行为共享相同的容量。通过二元事件比较，可以在每个引出的水平上识别局部事件权重，并追踪其跨水平的变化，从而为检验固定容量限制提供方法。局部不确定性厌恶等价于 ν_v 的凸性，并给出一个隐式的多先验表示。
tldr: 本文公理化了一个模糊性权重依赖于行为确定性等价所对应效用水平的新决策模型，用一族随效用水平变化的容量来解释模糊态度为何随决策环境系统性变化。
en_tdlr: This paper axiomatizes a novel decision model in which ambiguity weights depend on the utility level of an act's certainty equivalent, using a family of level-dependent capacities to explain why ambiguity attitudes vary systematically with decision circumstances.
